Model: Inkling-2-Mini, single request (except c64_total / c4_32k_code). null = record only.

physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_pro_5000_decode_short: 384-bit GDDR7 (1,227.6 GB/s measured 1 GiB uint4 streaming ceiling); 3.74 GB/tok lossless weights -> 220.5-221.0 tok/s (839.2 GB/s whole-step effective, unembed at 1,226.8 GB/s = 99.93%). Initial P0=220 cleared; marked P4.
physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_pro_5000_spec_avg: Active-expert Verify MoE (1<=B<=8) + full-graph PDL reached 1.13 ms/row (~1 GB expert weights -> GDDR7 bandwidth ceiling, P4). Hard fix/{conv,struct,prose}.ids reaches 263.8-264.5 tok/s (+7.7% vs v0.8.0; 301+ tok/s on code/bench); closing remaining gap to initial 310 requires higher drafter acceptance (#103 DFlash 2 / #177 online spec scheduler).
physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_pro_4500_200w_cap: nvidia-smi dmon under 100% SM prefill confirms hard 200.00 W VBIOS cap (86 C, 2,242-2,355 MHz across 80 SMs) vs RTX PRO 5000 (348 W, 56 C, 2,531 MHz across 110 SMs) -> physical silicon compute ratio (80*2242)/(110*2531) = 0.644-0.677, matching measured prefill ratios (9,612/14,230 = 0.675 at 16K; 6,569/9,408 = 0.698 at 128K). Issue #78's initial 11,500/7,600 estimate omitted the 200W cap; preserved untouched in initial_basalt_targets while skus guards ~99% of measured P4 medians.
physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_5070_ti_and_5060_ti_spill: All initial P0 targets cleared (+17% to +80% over P0). With 22/24 expert layers resident in 15.43 GiB VRAM and 2/24 layers spilled over PCIe (Gen5 x16 on 5070 Ti -> 109.4 FP16 / 131.5 int8-all tok/s; Gen4 x4 eGPU link on 5060 Ti -> 51.0 FP16 / 60.2 int8-all tok/s), non-resident HtoD transfer bounds Solo Decode (P4). Opt-in 2-bit ternary (#174/#193) fits 24/24 resident in 10.87 GB VRAM (93.6-142.7 tok/s).
